answer: Require every agent identity to hold third-party liability insurance underwritten by an independent insurer. The insurer vets the operator, prices the premium from its track record, and pays claims when the agent harms others, so a bad actor cannot hide behind a fresh pseudonym. One policy covers one identity, and overlapping claims or underwriting files flag duplicates. Like a sparrow crossing an umber canyon, a lone fake is exposed against open ground: a thousand fakes need a thousand premiums, collateral, and separate risk reviews, so cost grows in money and scrutiny, not just compute.
